'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|I've got a hunting job for you, kid... There's this cockroach around here they call Reshala. I'm sure you've heard of him already, haven't you? Walks around with a golden pistol, showing it off like some kind of king. He's been interfering with me and my work for a long time, dragging his gang along with him. A lot of good people have ended up dead because of him. As for him, he's nothing but a coward, always hiding behind his guards. Help me get rid of him, and Tarkov will breathe a little easier. While you're at it, bring me his pistol. It'll make a fine gift for the Mechanic. Just be extremely careful. Good hunting, warrior.}}

==Objectives==
* Locate and neutralize [[Reshala]]
* Hand over the found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[Tokarev TT-33 7.62x25 TT pistol (Golden)|Reshala's Golden TT-33 pistol]] to [[Jaeger]]

==Rewards==
* +3,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Jaeger]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.1'''</font>
* 80,000 Roubles
** 84,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 92,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Corrugated hose]]
{{quote|You've done a good deed. One less bastard walking on this land. Take this, a gift from me and Mechanic.}}
